title: Introduction to Expo Components
overview: Expo provides many built-in components and libraries that help developers access mobile features and create user interfaces faster.

title: View and Text Components
overview: View and Text are basic React Native components used to create layouts and display text content.

title: Image Component
overview: The Image component is used to display local or remote images inside an Expo application.

title: Pressable and Touchable Components
overview: Pressable and Touchable components are used to handle user interactions like button presses and gestures.

title: Expo Vector Icons
overview: Expo provides icon libraries that allow developers to use ready-made icons in their applications.

title: Reusable Components
overview: Reusable components improve code organization by allowing the same UI elements to be used in multiple screens.

title: Topic Summary
overview: You learned about common Expo and React Native components, user interaction components, icons, and reusable UI design.
